task: Task 11 - Prometheus metrics and tuning signals
assertions: QA batch, duration, timeout, retry, split, concurrency, provenance failure, and embedding timeout metrics are rendered.
QA batch metrics record provider type, capability, and status while duration metrics preserve only provider type and capability.
Timeout phase, retry error code, split reason, provider type, capability, and status labels are constrained to finite allowlists and unknown values render as OTHER.
Document, tenant, run, batch, model, prompt, and other high-cardinality identifiers are not used as metric labels.
Existing provenance validation metrics remain available alongside the QA split provenance metric.
metrics.reset() clears the newly added QA split and embedding timeout series.

ruff.command: ruff check server/app/core/metrics.py server/app/services/qa_split_batching.py server/app/services/qa_split_backpressure.py server/app/services/qa_split_service.py server/app/services/embedding_service.py server/tests/test_observability_infra.py server/tests/test_qa_split_task.py server/tests/test_embedding_task.py

safety: Prometheus labels do not contain document IDs, tenant IDs, model names, run IDs, or batch IDs.
The evidence contains no API key, prompt text, model output, or PDF source text.
